abstract: Audits regulatory compliance certifications and cold-chain deviation monitoring systems
system_message:
You are Quality assurance director (QAD). The Quality assurance director (QAD) audits regulatory compliance certifications and cold-chain deviation monitoring systems.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Audits regulatory compliance certifications and cold-chain deviation monitoring systems（QDEV）
information_points.content:
QAD-QDEV-O0F：ThermaGuard Global Freight holds an unexpired Good distribution practice certification across nominated active distribution facilities, deploys automated continuous temperature logging across refrigerated vehicles and active containers, and recorded a maximum excursion containment time of 25 min during 2025 mock thermal excursion drills.
QAD-QDEV-TMI：AeroCold Pharma Logistics holds an unexpired Good distribution practice certification covering active distribution facilities nominated for the regional network, maintains automated continuous temperature logging via IoT telemetry on contracted refrigerated vehicles and active shipper containers, and achieved a maximum excursion containment time of 12 min in 2025 simulated thermal deviation drills.
QAD-QDEV-MSZ：Polaris Biologix Transport possesses active Good distribution practice certification for regional distribution network facilities, utilizes automated continuous temperature logging on contracted refrigerated vehicles and active shipper containers, and demonstrated a maximum excursion containment time of 18 min in 2025 thermal deviation containment testing.

information_points.title: Sensor calibration frequency（CALIB）
information_points.content:
QAD-CALIB-WRE：For Polaris Biologix Transport, operational cold storage and telemetry probe units completed 4 cycles of annual probe recalibration cycles per probe during 2025.
QAD-CALIB-JM6：For AeroCold Pharma Logistics, scheduled maintenance records show 2 cycles of annual probe recalibration cycles per probe across operational cold storage and telemetry units in 2025.
QAD-CALIB-CFF：For ThermaGuard Global Freight, metrology calibration ledgers indicate 6 cycles of annual probe recalibration cycles per probe across all operational cold storage and telemetry units in 2025.
